intro.title: An engineer focused on systems, not just code.
paragraphs: My work sits at the intersection of AI engineering, backend systems, DevOps, and modern web development. I enjoy building software that is not only functional, but also scalable, reliable, observable, and maintainable.

Most of my strongest work is behind the scenes: backend services, APIs, infrastructure, automation, AI workflows, deployment systems, and architecture decisions. These are not always visible in a user interface, but they are the foundation that makes serious software work.

At the same time, I care about frontend quality. A strong product needs clean interfaces, good performance, thoughtful UX, and clear communication. That is why I also build polished React and Next.js experiences that reflect the quality of the systems behind them.

journey.title: From analytical thinking to production AI systems.
journey.description: My path combines scientific thinking, backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and modern AI development.

timeline.title: Physics Background
timeline.description: My academic background in Physics shaped the way I approach engineering: analytical thinking, problem decomposition, systems understanding, and curiosity about how complex things work.

timeline.title: Software Engineering
timeline.description: I started building production software with a strong focus on backend development, APIs, databases, and scalable application architecture.

timeline.title: Distributed Systems & APIs
timeline.description: Over the years, I worked deeply with Node.js, TypeScript, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL, gRPC, microservices, event-driven systems, and production backend platforms.

timeline.title: Cloud, Containers & Automation
timeline.description: I expanded into Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and production deployment workflows to understand how software runs beyond the codebase.

timeline.title: Production AI Engineering
timeline.description: My recent focus is building AI systems with LLMs, AI agents, MCP servers, RAG pipelines, vector databases, OpenAI, Ollama, LangChain, Python, and TypeScript services.
